transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in today?

Well... my supervisor sent me, mostly. I, uh... I got a little spooked the other day and told him what's been in my head. Just... I keep having these thoughts that maybe my family would be better off if I just didn't wake up in the morning. It shook me up enough to say something at work. So... that's why I'm here.
How long have you been having these thoughts and feelings of low mood—days, weeks, or longer?
I'd say... about two weeks. Just... since my daughter left. She, uh, she shipped out of Georgia for the military, and... I don't know. This whole change in me just sort of started then.
Have you ever had a period like this before—either feeling this low, or on the flip side, a stretch where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep?

I don't... I don't really know about that energetic stuff. But feeling low... I guess, looking back on it... these low stretches have been coming around for about a year now. 

Just... not like this. This one, after she left, it just... it's hit me the hardest.
Thinking back over the past year, did those earlier low periods last at least two weeks each time, and did you feel back to your normal self in between them?

I couldn't really tell you. I don't... I didn't keep track of the days like that. Maybe a couple weeks? I'm not sure. 

And... I don't know about feeling normal in between. I just sort of... went back to work. I didn't really pay much attention to it back then.
During this past year, between those low periods, were there any stretches of time—maybe a few weeks or more—where you felt like your usual self again?
I don't know... I guess so. I just went to work, came home... did what I had to do. I didn't really think about whether I felt like my usual self or not. It was just... normal life, I suppose.

During those earlier low periods this past year, were you experiencing things like poor sleep, low energy, trouble concentrating, or loss of interest in things, similar to how you've been feeling these past two weeks, or were they milder and less disruptive to your daily life?

I couldn't really tell you about the sleep or... the concentration and all that. I just know they weren't as bad as this time. 

Milder, I guess you could say. I still got my job done, so... I didn't really dwell on it.
Over this past year, would you say you were feeling down more days than not almost continuously, or did the low periods come and go with weeks in between where you felt completely fine?
I don't really know. Like I said, I don't keep track of the days. I just... I don't think it was continuous. They probably came and went. I just went to work.
During these past two weeks since your daughter left, has your low mood been present nearly every day, most of the day, without any breaks where you felt okay again?

I haven't really kept track of it like that. It's just... been a rough couple of weeks since she moved out. I don't know about breaks or counting the hours. It's just been hard to shake, I guess. I'm just trying to get through it.
During those earlier low periods over the past year, did you notice a loss of interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy, similar to what you're experiencing now?

I don't know about back then. I wasn't paying attention. But lately... I don't know. I used to mess with my tomato plants out back, or sand some wood at my bench. Watch the Falcons on Sunday. Even just... staying after church to talk. But now I just... I look at all that stuff and it's like it belongs to somebody else. I just don't care about it right now.
Over these past two weeks, have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping much more or less than usual?
I don't know... I haven't really noticed anything different. I just go to bed when I'm tired. I guess I sleep fine. I'm not really keeping track of it.
Between those earlier low periods this past year, can you recall ever going two months or longer where you felt essentially back to your normal self, without any low mood at all?
I don't really know. I don't keep a calendar of how I feel. Sometimes I'm fine, sometimes I'm not. I don't think I've ever counted the months between.
During those milder low periods over the past year, did you also notice things like changes in your appetite or weight, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness, along with feeling down?

I eat fine, I guess. Haven't noticed my clothes fitting any different. And... I don't know about that other stuff. Guilt, or whatever. I don't really sit around dwelling on things like that. I just... I don't remember it being an issue back then.
During those earlier low periods this past year, did they ever interfere with your ability to function at work or with your family, or were you always able to carry on as usual despite feeling low?

I just... I kept working. I always keep working. You just have to push through it, you know? I don't really let it get in the way of my job. As for my family... I don't know. We got by fine. I don't think it changed much.
Before this past year, going back two years or more, do you recall having similar stretches of feeling down, or did this pattern only start within the last year?
I couldn't really tell you. I don't... I don't spend much time looking backwards. Two years is a long time ago. I just know how it's been lately, I guess.

It's... I don't know. It's just worse, I guess. I can't really parse out if it's a different kind of bad or just... more of it. It's just hard right now. That's all I can really tell you.
Over these past two weeks, have you noticed any trouble concentrating or focusing on things, like reading, following conversations, or getting tasks done at work?

Yeah, I guess so. At the distribution center... I stare at the schedule, or the routing sheet, and my mind just won't lock in. Even little staffing calls feel bigger than they ought to. It's just hard to focus.

Thinking about those earlier low spells this past year—did you ever have a stretch, even briefly, where you lost interest in almost everything and had trouble functioning at work the way you're struggling now, or were those times always milder and manageable?
No... I don't think so. Before, I just... I always managed to get the job done. It was just regular bad days, I guess. Nothing like this.
